Recorded signed in-force holdings are Fan Engagement Analytics, Live Match Data Feed, Historical Stats Archive, Live Streaming.

usage.expected_rule: signed-term overlap in month or between first and last recorded usage observation
usage.yoy_rule: both full same-month windows observed; positive prior denominator for percentage
usage.yoy_rounding: percentage change to nearest 0.1 percentage point using half-up rounding

support.arrival_basis: opened date in an inclusive window
support.closure_and_csat_basis: closed date in an inclusive window
support.open_basis: opened by period end with no closure by period end; historical states are reconstructed from dates
